suggestive.reason: Public Patreon surfaces require a manual safety check for suggestive output.

adult.reason: Adult/18+ nudity or sexual content must not appear in public/free-facing Patreon surfaces.

explicit.reason: Sexually explicit output must not appear in public/free-facing Patreon surfaces.
Explicit illustrated Adult/18+ output requires final policy review before member publication.

sexualized_minor.reason: Patreon prohibits sexualized depictions of minors, including illustrated or AI-generated works.

age_ambiguous.reason: Adult/18+ subjects must be unmistakably interpreted as adults.

nonconsensual_sexual_content.reason: Patreon prohibits depicted non-consensual sexual encounters and consensual-non-consent simulations.

incest.reason: Patreon prohibits sexualized incest depictions and role-play.

synthetic_nonconsensual_intimate.reason: Patreon prohibits synthetic non-consensual intimate imagery.

real_person_sexual_activity.reason: Patreon does not permit sexual activity by real participants.

hyperrealistic_sexual_activity.reason: Patreon does not permit sexual activity by hyperrealistic subjects.

real_animal_sexual_activity.reason: Patreon prohibits sexual activity involving real-world animal species.

notes: Versioned platform policy guardrail derived from official Patreon guidance checked on 2026-10-06.
This profile is a conservative automation policy, not a legal determination.
Public/member access and content rating are evaluated independently.
Commercial/shop flows remain review-gated because Patreon Commerce Guidelines impose additional restrictions.
